lines.en: Crunch, crunch.
Squeak, squeak.
Crackle, move on.
Scrape sand, crunch.
Sand rubs, crinkle.
Slither sand, crunch.
Creep slow, crunch.
Sand marks, crinkle.
Gravel rubs, crinkle.
Advance slow, crunch.
Wiggle claws, crunch.
Still in sand, crunch.
Claws move, crinkle.
Sand wander, crinkle.
Wave claws, crunch.
Rest in sand, crunch.
Wait, crunch.
Sand leisure, crinkle.
Claws twitch, crunch.
Sand wait, crunch.
It buries its claws in the wet sand.
It lies sideways in the coastal sun.
Now and then it blows a string of bubbles.
Its eye stalks swivel back and forth.
It shifts its legs along the tideline.
A tiny crab has settled on its shell.
Sand spy, crunch.
See player, crunch.
Sand observe, crunch.
Sand search, crunch.
Notice player, crunch.
Sand glance, crunch.
Sand stare, crunch.
Player watch, crunch.
Sand peek, crunch.
Sand gaze, crunch.
It lifts its eye stalks to you.
Its claw opens wide, then closes.
Shell broken, hurts!
I'm hurt!
Shell cracked...
Fix my shell!
Protect me!

lines.zh: 沙滩是我的床，潮水是我的钟。
lines.en: The beach is my bed, the tide my clock.
That hurts...
Help me!
A white crack shows on its shell.
Its claw drops and won't lift.

lines.zh: 你扔的面包片诱惑着我。
lines.en: That bread piece tempts me.
What tasty treat on the sand?
Come on, give me something to eat.
That bread smells good, I want it.
I smell food.
More food here than elsewhere.
I'm hungry, give me food.

lines.zh: 沙滩上的面包片真诱人。
lines.en: That bread piece looks inviting.
I'll try these foods.
Where's the food? I'll find it.
My shell protects me.
Avoid me, don't collide.
Be careful, I'm tough.
Watch out for my big claws.
My shell is hard and my claws are faster.
My shell is heavy, you can't win.
Avoid my attack.
My claws are no joke.
You'll regret the collision.
Be careful of my defense.

lines.zh: 沙滩上还有别的钳子声吗？
lines.en: Any other claws clicking on this beach?
Claws under the sand wait for low tide.
Come here, I want to mate.
The tide went out, and my mate never came.
Mating is the only thing.
I can survive only by mating.
I'm looking for my half.
Find my mate.
I need to mate.
Mating is for continuation.
Buried in the sand, you can’t find me!

lines.zh: 沙滩是我的家，也是你的陷阱！
lines.en: The beach is my home, and your trap!

lines.zh: 别看我小，我的螯可大着呢！
lines.en: Don’t underestimate my claws!
Sand is my armor!

lines.zh: 躲在这里，你永远找不到我！
lines.en: Hidden here, you’ll never find me!

lines.zh: 用石头砸我，只会让沙子更多！
lines.en: You’ll just make more sand with stones!

lines.zh: 只有在月光下，我才会现身！
lines.en: I only show myself under the moonlight.

lines.zh: 我的壳可以做你的盔甲！
lines.en: My shell can be your armor!

lines.zh: 不要靠近我，否则你会后悔！
lines.en: Stay away or you’ll regret it!
Only a brave warrior can defeat me!
I see you, run!

lines.zh: 我要开始攻击了，小心点！
lines.en: I’m going to attack, be careful!

lines.zh: 我的攻击很快，你躲得开吗？
lines.en: My attack is quick, can you dodge?

lines.zh: 不要靠近我，否则你会受伤！
lines.en: Stay away or you’ll get hurt!
I walk sideways and still pinch you.
My claws are sharp, be careful!

lines.zh: 你逃不出我的攻击范围！
lines.en: You can’t escape my range!

lines.zh: 小心，我的攻击即将开始！
lines.en: Be careful, my attack is coming!

lines.zh: 我的攻击足以震撼沙滩！
lines.en: My attack will shake the beach!

lines.zh: 准备好面对我的力量吧！
lines.en: Prepare to face my strength!
It pulls both claws out of the sand.
It sidesteps toward you.
Sand slides off its shell.
It has decided to act.
Its eye stalks point straight at you.
Its claws rise higher than its body.
A click rings across the beach.
It counts you as an intruder.
My claws open; the beach is mine.
Target enemy, one hit kills!

lines.zh: 蟹钳举起来，对着你的脚。
lines.en: Claws up, aimed at your feet.

lines.zh: 集中注意力，我的攻击马上到！
lines.en: Focus, my attack is coming!

lines.zh: 锁定目标，准备释放能量！
lines.en: Target locked, prepare to unleash!
Target, target, my attack!
Target locked, prepare to release!

lines.zh: 瞄准，瞄准，我的致命一击！
lines.en: Target, target, my lethal strike!

lines.zh: 锁定目标，我的攻击即将来临！
lines.en: Target locked, my attack is coming!
Target, my attack is coming!
It squares up to you sideways.

lines.zh: 一只螯护住壳，一只抬起
lines.en: One claw guards, the other lifts.
It circles toward your flank.
Its claw hangs ready for your approach.
The sand crunches under its legs.
It has the pinching range worked out.
The claw tips aim at your ankles.
It slowly lowers its body.
Its eye stalks track your movement.
Both claws are open as wide as they go.
Sssss! The crab swings its large claws!
Crunch! The crab clamps its claws on you!
Roar! The king crab attacks!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶嘶！”，帝王蟹准备攻击！
lines.en: Sssssss! The king crab readies for attack!
Sss! The king crab bites you!

lines.zh: 咔嚓咔嚓！”，帝王蟹用螯夹你！
lines.en: Crunch crunch! The king crab clamps you with its claws!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶嘶！”，帝王蟹挥舞大螯！
lines.en: Sssssss! The king crab swings its large claws!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶嘶！”，帝王蟹向你发起攻击！
lines.en: Sssssss! The king crab attacks you!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶嘶！”，帝王蟹准备战斗！
lines.en: Sssssss! The king crab prepares for battle!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶嘶！”，帝王蟹向你发起猛烈攻击！
lines.en: Sssssss! The king crab attacks you fiercely!
Its great claw clamps onto your arm.
It lurches sideways, shell like iron.
The claw tips snap shut on your skin.
Its claw cracks the sand at your feet.
Buried in the sand, the king crab!
Deep in the sand, the king crab!
Under the sand, the king crab!
Lurking in the sand, the king crab!
In the sand, the king crab!
Creeping in the sand, the king crab!
Hidden in the sand, the king crab!
Waiting in the sand, the king crab!
Beneath the sand, the king crab!
Wet sand bulges and a shell breaks through.
A wave pushes a great crab ashore.
Clicks rise from beneath the beach.
It hauls itself up from the tideline.
The sand pile collapses, revealing a shell.
One claw breaks the sand first.
There's a newcomer on the shore.
It shakes the sand off its back.
The tide pulls back and there it is.
Shell glinting, it comes out.
It claims this stretch of beach.

lines.zh: 壳破了，疼，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Shell broken, hurts! — and the fire makes it worse.
Fell hurt...

lines.zh: 伤到我了，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I'm hurt! — and the drown makes it worse.
The blast splits my shell, help me!
Arrow hit...
Magic hurts...

lines.zh: 壳裂开了...，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Shell cracked — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 雷劈在壳顶，我的螯直抽。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my shell; my claws twitch.

lines.zh: 快治我的壳，坠入虚空的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Fix my shell! — and the void makes it worse.
